statement: A cylinder 40 mm diameter and 60 mm long has its axis inclined at 30° to the H.P. and parallel to the V.P. Draw its projections when one of its base points is on the H.P.

placement.restingCondition: Base perimeter point on HP, axis inclined at 30° to HP

notes: Axis in plan is foreshortened to 60 * cos(30°) = 51.96 mm. Overall front view height is 60 * sin(30°) + 40 * cos(30°) = 30 + 34.64 = 64.64 mm.
